_comment: Copy this file to vendor/limezu-pack/import-config.json and edit to match the actual layout of LimeZu's Modern Interiors Character Generator pack. The vendor dir is gitignored so the real config lives there. Run with --discover first to inspect the unzipped pack and fill these in.
_step1_pickSize: LimeZu ships 16x16, 32x32, 48x48 — pick which size folder you want to import from. Recommend 48 for hi-fi pixel feel.
_step2_spritesheetOrSingles: If LimeZu's character generator ships SPRITESHEETS (animation frames in a grid), set spritesheet block. If it ships individual already-cropped per-pose PNGs, omit the block entirely and the importer will copy the file as-is.
_step3_bustCrop: Bust-region rect inside the full-body sprite — used by /api/og to extract the share-card portrait. Eyeball this against the actual sprite once you can see one. Origin is top-left.
_step4_rules: Each rule maps a regex against pack-relative file paths to a category + ID resolution strategy. Run --discover first; the discover output prints the actual folder structure so you can write accurate match patterns.

rules._: Bodies — one PNG per skin tone. ID becomes the slugified filename.
Hair — folder per style, file per color variant. Capture both via regex named groups.
Outfits — modern/streetwear single-piece body covers. ID = slugified filename.
Accessories — glasses, scarves, jewelry. Slot is optional in schema (defaults to 'none').

_step5_labels: Optional friendly labels keyed by id. Anything missing falls back to title-cased id.
